# Determine deletions for songs and albums
liked_song_ids=set(s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs)
downloaded_song_ids=set(s['song_id'] for s in downloaded_songs)
keep_song_ids=liked_song_ids | downloaded_song_ids
song_library_ids=[s['song_id'] for s in song_library]
remove_song_ids=[sid for sid in song_library_ids if sid not in keep_song_ids]
print('song_library_count', len(song_library_ids))
print('keep_song_ids_in_library', len(song_library_ids)-len(remove_song_ids))
print('remove_song_ids_count', len(remove_song_ids))
print('remove_song_ids', remove_song_ids)

liked_album_ids=set(a['album_id'] for a in liked_albums)
album_library_ids=[a['album_id'] for a in album_library]
# downloaded album definition: all songs in album are downloaded
album_downloaded_ids=set()
for a in album_library:
    song_ids=a.get('song_ids', [])
    if song_ids and all((sid in downloaded_song_ids) for sid in song_ids):
        album_downloaded_ids.add(a['album_id'])
# albums to keep
keep_album_ids=liked_album_ids | album_downloaded_ids
remove_album_ids=[aid for aid in album_library_ids if aid not in keep_album_ids]
print('album_library_count', len(album_library_ids))
print('liked_album_ids_count', len(liked_album_ids))
print('album_downloaded_ids_count', len(album_downloaded_ids))
print('keep_album_ids_in_library', len(album_library_ids)-len(remove_album_ids))
print('remove_album_ids_count', len(remove_album_ids))
print('remove_album_ids', remove_album_ids)

# For transparency, print each album kept/removed with reasons
for a in album_library:
    aid=a['album_id']
    liked = aid in liked_album_ids
    downloaded = aid in album_downloaded_ids
    removed = aid in remove_album_ids
    if removed:
        # determine why: liked? downloaded?; compute missing songs
        song_ids=a.get('song_ids', [])
        missing=[sid for sid in song_ids if sid not in downloaded_song_ids]
        print('REMOVE album', aid, a['title'], 'liked', liked, 'downloaded', downloaded, 'missing_song_ids', missing)
    else:
        if liked and downloaded:
            reason='liked+downloaded'
        elif liked:
            reason='liked'
        else:
            reason='downloaded'
        print('KEEP album', aid, a['title'], 'reason', reason)
